_comment: JC5 per-license request-signature parity vector (Docs/licensing-contract.md v1.13). One canonical (key, method, path, timestamp, nonce, body) and the lower-case-hex HMAC-SHA256 it must produce. Both the Deno verifier (requestSignature.ts) and Plan B's Swift signer must reproduce `signature` byte-for-byte. The `key` is a throwaway test string, NOT a real license key. Message = [METHOD, path, timestamp, nonce, sha256hex(body)].join('\n'); signature = hmacSha256hex(key, message).
